contentText: Paris Saint-Germain and Arsenal face off in the Champions League final in Budapest on Saturday, with the biggest prize in European club football up for grabs. Title holders PSG can become only the second team in the modern era to retain the trophy, but Arsenal head into the game on a fresh high after lifting the Premier League title for the first time in 22 years. Follow the match on our liveblog, kickoff is at 6pm local time (GMT+2).
